candidates.change_summary: Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` check so SetMinSum can still set MinSum after initialization.
Delete the assignment `MinSum = _val;` so MinSum never changes via SetMinSum.
Move `MinSum = _val;` before the initialized check so MinSum is updated even when the call reverts.
Delete `locked_ = false;` from the modifier so the lock is never released, making any SetMinSum call after the first one revert and leaving MinSum unchanged.
Remove the statement that assigns MinSum = _val, so SetMinSum no longer updates the MinSum state variable.
Remove the initialization guard so SetMinSum still writes MinSum even after the contract has been Initialized, instead of reverting.
Replace the assignment MinSum = _val with MinSum = 0, so the getter always returns 0 after SetMinSum.

Remove the trailing locked_ = false so the lock is never released; a first nonReentrant call (e.g. SetLogFile) leaves locked_ true, causing a subsequent SetMinSum call to revert and leave MinSum unchanged.
Remove the `if(intitalized) revert();` guard so SetLogFile can overwrite the LogFile address even after initialization.
Replace the assignment so the LogFile address is set to msg.sender instead of the _log parameter.
